text: This is supposedly based on Washington only scoring ~2ppg more than Deebo, but that seems WAY off, where is that coming from and can we review and confirm

That comparison isn't on the card, so I can't tell you where it came from or confirm it.

What the card does say:
- **Value (this card):** you +13 total, with this season +23 and later seasons -10. First-place odds go from 56% to 63% and title odds from 39% to 43%.
- **Reason (this card):** it cites payout (P18), cap room and strength by year, and picks given at -107 points over their rookie deals.

The card has no Deebo, no points-per-game figure for Washington, and no per-player breakdown of the +23 this season. The Week 11 lineup does show Washington as a starting WR3, so losing him is a real cost. But I have no projections here to say how big it is or how he compares to anyone else.

Two other things to know:
- The card's 56% first-place figure doesn't match the brief's 55% for you. That's likely just timing, since the inputs are about 3 minutes apart.
- Data health notes that 1 step was not ok in recent engine runs. I can't tell from here whether that touches this trade.

To check Washington's projection against Deebo's and see what the sim assumed, I'd need data that isn't here. I'd suggest "Send to the sync for a full re-check", and I'd hold off on proposing anything until that comes back. The confidence is already marked low.

Re-checked. The ~2 ppg is the rest-of-season rate (proj_ros.csv, 20:57 UTC): Washington 12.25, Deebo 9.96. The inputs (nflverse stats through Week 10, FantasyPros):
- Season average: Washington 13.3 (9 games), Deebo 12.8 (6 games; out Weeks 6-9).
- Expected points from usage: Washington 11.2, Deebo 7.1.
- FantasyPros: Washington ranked in Week 10 (about 11.9 a game); Deebo has had no rank since his Week 7 injury.
On the data, a gap of about 2 holds. Deebo's actual scoring points to a smaller gap and his usage to a bigger one. I'm keeping it.

Your check did find a real fault, though. From Tuesday to Thursday, before the week's FantasyPros ranks come out, every rest-of-season rate was dropping its FantasyPros half. In the 2021-25 backtest, keeping last week's rank does better: error 2.22-2.34 vs 2.37-2.55. That's fixed now, with a test (projections/current.py; docs/projections.md). Walker goes from 21.6 to 19.7 ppg, Washington from 12.25 to 12.06, and Deebo is unchanged.

What changes: the target version is now you +$7 (this season +17, later -10; 1st place 56%->61%, title 38%->42%), down from +$14. A 6,000-sim recheck gives +$2, and if Washington is really 2 ppg better than projected it's -$8. So the target is about break-even. Only the opening (two 2027 2nds instead of the 2029 1st: you +$13 to +$18, Ben +$5) is clearly in your favor, and I wouldn't go up to the 2029 1st. The playoff-adds card changed too: James Cook and Chase Brown, and Walker dropped off.
